style: Original adult editorial-comic illustration with controlled black ink, warm muted cream/teal/ochre/rust/burgundy palette, natural skin tones, subtle paper and halftone texture; no named-artist imitation.

constraints: Portrait 9:16; consistent characters and geography; no generated dialogue, labels, logos, watermarks, motion blur, duplicated people, or confusing mirror reflections. All readable text is added later as a deterministic overlay.
